name: Kaede Yuzuna
source:
A childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c2728]Tomone[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url]. 

She is an underclassman of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url] and the classmate of [url=https://vndb.org/c2728]Tomone[/url]. In the group of childhood friend, she is like the "[url=https://vndb.org/g110]younger sister[/url]" of the overs.

She is a playful girl but has fainted several times in the past due to her suffering from anemia.

[spoiler]She gave her first kiss to [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] several years ago when they were kids at a "wedding play", next to the "secret base", behind the temple. Since that time, she's jealous that [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url] has taken [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url]'s first kiss by force and also realized that her friends, [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2728]Tomone[/url], also liked [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url].

When she faint, she can count on her over childhood friend [url=https://vndb.org/c2728]Tomone[/url] who always takes a very good care of her.

She has unbounded admiration for [url=https://vndb.org/c69495]penguins[/url].

In her route, she decides to keep her relation with [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] secret for don't hurt the feelings of her friends [url=https://vndb.org/c2728]Tomone[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url].[/spoiler]
